title: Field development plan wizard and review
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-6 met: the wizard saves step values into a draft and a submit locks it while naming the first missing step; a review records a decision with a rationale, a return names the step to correct, and the author cannot review their own plan; an approval appends an immutable baseline; a revision starts a new draft from the latest baseline and its approval appends a second baseline while the first stays readable; costs are decimals with an explicit currency.

dataModel.decision: DevelopmentPlanning had a plan service that returned in-memory projections and no draft, baseline or review persistence. The plan's own contract and DEV-02's acceptance criteria were implemented as three DevelopmentPlanning-owned tables, registered in DevelopmentPlanningModule, following the WELL_PROGRAM (EXP-05) and LEASE_TERM (LSE-03) pattern.
tables: FDP_DRAFT (DRAFT_ID key, FDP_ID, FIELD_ID, VERSION, STATE, CURRENT_STEP, AUTHOR, SCOPE_TEXT, RESERVOIR_TEXT, WELL_COUNT, FACILITY_TEXT, COST_AMOUNT, COST_CURRENCY, RISK_TEXT, BASELINE_ID, RETURNED_STEP, RETURN_REASON) - the editable wizard document
FDP_BASELINE (BASELINE_ID key, FDP_ID, DRAFT_ID, VERSION, APPROVED_AT, APPROVED_BY, CONDITIONS_TEXT, and the frozen scope/reservoir/wells/facility/cost/risk) - append-only, never updated
FDP_REVIEW (REVIEW_ID key, DRAFT_ID, FDP_ID, DECISION, RATIONALE, RETURNED_STEP, CONDITIONS_TEXT, REVIEWER, REVIEWED_AT) - append-only review history
dataModel.registration: Beep.OilandGas.DevelopmentPlanning/Modules/DevelopmentPlanningModule.cs registers the three types; the module summary in --smoke reports 358 entity types (up from 355).

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Development/OgFdpWizard.cs (OgFdpDraft, OgFdpBaseline, OgFdpReview, OgFdpDraftValues, OgFdpDecision, OgFdpPlan, OgFdpWorkspace, OgFdpSubmit, IOgFdpWizard, OgFdpWizardService with Steps/StepName/MissingSteps/CreateDraftAsync/SaveDraftAsync/SubmitAsync/ReviewAsync/ReviseAsync/RetrySubmitAsync)
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/FdpWizardPageView.cs (route 'fdpwizard': plan picker, seven-step wizard fields, submit/revise/retry, review decision with returned step and conditions, baseline grid, detail with missing steps and reviews)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgFdpWizard), OgApplication.FdpWizard, catalog 'fdpwizard' (OgModuleKeys.Development), OgPageFactory, en + ar labels
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/FdpWizardTests.cs (8, no database) + FdpWizardGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite with FIELD_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN, FDP_DRAFT, FDP_BASELINE, FDP_REVIEW and DEVELOPMENT_WELL_SCHEDULE, seeded in FdpWizardGatewayTests
integration.ac1_create_save_submit: CreateDraftAsync writes the plan row and its first draft; SaveDraftAsync writes all seven step values; the saved draft has no missing step; SubmitAsync moves draft and plan to SUBMITTED
integration.ac1_locked: after the submit, SaveDraftAsync is refused with fdp-draft-locked and nothing is written
integration.ac3_return: a RETURN names step 4; the draft becomes RETURNED with RETURNED_STEP=4 and ReturnText 'Step 4 (Facilities and capacity): capacity is not justified'; the returned draft is editable and resubmittable
integration.ac4_author: the author reviewing their own plan is refused with fdp-author-cannot-approve
integration.ac5_money: the approval baseline stores COST_AMOUNT 1200 and COST_CURRENCY USD; the unit test proves a negative cost and a missing currency are refused
integration.ac2_baseline: approving appends one FDP_BASELINE at version 1 with the draft's frozen values
integration.ac6_revision: ReviseAsync creates draft version 2 from baseline 1; approving it appends baseline 2 (1500 USD, two conditions); baseline 1 is still readable with 1200 USD and its original scope
integration.lost_ack: a SQLite trigger made the draft update fail: the submit was refused and retained in Pending; after the trigger was dropped RetrySubmitAsync submitted the same draft
integration.field_scope: the other field's plan is absent; the loaded plan holds 2 baselines and 3 reviews (return, approve, approve-with-conditions)

gates.AC-1 The wizard saves a draft and the su: pass - SaveDraftAsync persists every step value and the current step; SubmitAsync first lists any missing step (and moves CURRENT_STEP to the first one) and otherwise moves the draft and the plan row to SUBMITTED; editing a submitted draft is refused with fdp-draft-locked.
gates.AC-2 An approval appends a baseline and: pass - approving writes an FDP_BASELINE row; ReviseAsync creates the next draft version from the latest baseline; its approval appends a second baseline, and the gateway test reads baseline 1 unchanged afterwards.
gates.AC-3 A return names the step to correct: pass - a RETURN requires RETURNED_STEP in 1..6, stores it on the draft and the review, and the draft's ReturnText names the step and the reason; the page shows it.
gates.AC-4 The author cannot approve their own: pass - ReviewAsync compares the draft author with the reviewer and refuses with fdp-author-cannot-approve; proven against SQLite.
gates.AC-5 Costs are decimals with an explicit: pass - COST_AMOUNT is a decimal and COST_CURRENCY is required when the amount is above zero; a negative amount and a missing currency are refused with named codes.
gates.AC-6 The baseline history is immutable: pass - FDP_BASELINE rows are only ever inserted; the service never updates or deletes one, and the second approval leaves the first baseline's cost and scope intact.

limits: The wizard is one scrolling page with a step picker, not a stepper control; the seven step names and the current step are the same data either way.

The draft stores the step values as text and numbers on FDP_DRAFT; the well-schedule step is satisfied by the existence of a DEVELOPMENT_WELL_SCHEDULE row for the plan, and the schedule itself is authored by DEV-03/DEV-05.
The baseline stores the plan scope, reservoir, well count, facility, cost and risk; it does not copy the schedule rows, which stay owned by DEV-03/DEV-05.
The plan row keeps a single FDP_STATUS, so it reflects the newest draft state; the per-draft state is authoritative and is what the reviews and baselines are keyed on.
The new tables need the DEVELOPMENT_PLANNING module applied again on an existing database to be created.
